idea-plugin.name: Config Doctor
idea-plugin.description:
Config Doctor detects suspicious Spring Boot YAML configuration structures (for example, an accidentally duplicated nesting level, such as spring.datasource.datasource.url instead of spring.datasource.url) before the application is started.

It flags the duplicated path with a WARNING-level inspection that explains the actual path, the related expected path (an actual, currently-used property found elsewhere in the project), and why the relationship is suspicious, and offers a Quick Fix to safely collapse the duplicated segment when doing so is unambiguous.

See the project README and CLAUDE.md for full scope and limitations - this is a focused, deterministic static-analysis tool, not a generic YAML linter or an AI assistant.
